# Part A — Findings

*Generated by `make render` from `ablation, adversarial, analysis, bench, corpus_stats, partc, sample_manifest`. Commit
`f04b85aee0d89cf60f3640561628d24c896959bf-dirty` · seed `1337`.*

Each block below is one ablation flag: a single behavioural change measured
against a baseline that reproduces `starter_kit/fertility.py` exactly
(`make parity`). Numbers are Hindi, macro tokens/word, on the `devtest`
corpus under `NFC`.

## Effect on the reported numbers

The v0 deck's figures come from `starter_kit/corpus_sample/`, not from the
evaluation corpus. This table re-runs the same flag grid over that same input,
so each row is what the report *would have printed* under one isolated change.
The `baseline` row reproduces the published values exactly — that is the parity
gate, and it is what makes every other row a statement about the report.

| flag | eng tok/word | hin tok/word | eng tok/char | hin tok/char | hin:eng |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `baseline` | 1.27 | 7.45 | 0.226 | 1.579 | 5.89 |
| `all_on` | 1.23 | 7.52 | 0.214 | 2.441 | 6.11 |
| `grapheme_denominator` | 1.27 | 7.45 | 0.226 | 2.450 | 5.89 |
| `micro_aggregate` | 1.25 | 7.40 | 0.221 | 1.583 | 5.91 |
| `perturb_global_rng` | 1.27 | 7.45 | 0.226 | 1.579 | 5.89 |
| `preserve_case` | 1.23 | 7.45 | 0.220 | 1.579 | 6.06 |
| `skip_nfc_normalisation` | 1.27 | 7.45 | 0.226 | 1.579 | 5.89 |
| `split_on_unicode_whitespace` | 1.28 | 7.60 | 0.226 | 1.579 | 5.92 |
